description: This file defines the OLERead class used for reading and parsing OLE compound document files, including methods for reading streams and directory entries, and handling internal structures like big and small block chains.

classes.name: OLERead
classes.description: A class for reading and parsing OLE compound document files, providing methods to read streams, directory entries, and handle internal block chains.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads and parses an OLE file, verifying its identifier and loading internal structures.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Extracts binary stream data from the OLE file given a stream index.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Reads a standard stream by following sector chains using the SAT.

methods.name: readPropertySets
methods.description: Reads directory entries from the directory stream, populating properties like workbook, root, and summary info.

methods.name: getInt4d
methods.description: Reads 4 bytes of data at a specified position, handling 32-bit and 64-bit systems correctly.
